description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and Training Time (s) for two methods, labeled Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis represents Training Time (s) on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250000 with tick marks at intervals of 50000. The y-axis represents Loss on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The Vanilla method is depicted by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers, which begins off-chart above a loss of 2.75, has its first visible marker at approximately 25000 seconds with a loss of 2.69, and continuously declines to end at approximately 245000 seconds with a loss of 2.50. The SepLLM method is shown as a solid red line with circular markers, also starting off-chart above 2.75, with its first visible marker at roughly 15000 seconds and a loss of 2.71, and declining steadily to end at approximately 235000 seconds with a loss of 2.49. Additionally, the plot features a horizontal dashed green line at a loss of 2.50. Two vertical dashed green lines drop from this horizontal line to the x-axis: one intersecting the SepLLM line at approximately 195000 seconds, and the other intersecting the end of the Vanilla line at approximately 245000 seconds, with both intersections marked by green stars. A horizontal green double-headed arrow labeled "1.26x" spans the gap between these two vertical dashed lines.
